adoption.rule: desktop reachability starts at host/profiles/desktop.json and follows the entire tracked host TS graph; only desktop-adopted is a requirement, explicit mobile evidence is retained, and desktop-unwired is not called mobile-only

items.behavior: get/set/delete secrets isolated by the calling plugin id, under secret.plugin.<pluginId>.<key>; empty set deletes and non-plugin callers are rejected
items.android: store per-owner credential records in Keystore-backed storage; owner isolation and delete semantics survive restart, pairing never copies trust or installation

items.behavior: notify(title, body, view?, params?, silent?) goes through the system notification policy and opens the owner plugin view on click; policy suppression returns delivered=false
items.android: notification channel plus deep link into the owning plugin view; suppressed/ unavailable results are returned, cancellation and uninstall remove the click target

items.behavior: daily/weekly/interval/startup jobs, one run at a time, local-time slots, one catch-up after a missed daily or weekly slot, persisted last/since state, owner cancel on unload
items.android: map jobs into the WorkManager-backed task ledger with unique work names; missed-run policy, no overlap, uninstall cancellation and notification/event release stay owner-scoped

items.behavior: JSON facade over notes, cards, question sets/questions, FSRS review stats/due/enqueue, todos and resource search/readText; writes use the same repositories, indexes and change events as official UI
items.android: consume official Kotlin repositories and synchronization paths, not plugin-only tables; preserve cursors, optimistic conflicts, list limits and STUDY_DATA_INVALID/NOT_FOUND/UNAVAILABLE errors

items.behavior: study events are emitted after the action completes in a microtask; listener failures are logged without affecting the producer, and subscriptions end with the plugin owner
items.android: emit only after repository commit and publish the event payload fields cardId/cardStateId, sessionId/messageId/content/question/durationMs, cardIds/documentId without blocking official writes

items.behavior: manifest agentTools are offered as plugin_<digest>_<name>, resolved through the owner service per call, serial and medium/high sensitivity, plain-JSON arguments/results, declared net hosts only, and withdrawn on disable or uninstall
items.android: register plugin tools in ToolDispatcher with the same namespaced IDs, capability checks, cancellation, result budget and approval policy; no plugin may impersonate a built-in or MCP tool

items.behavior: a successful plugin tool result marks the turn as carrying external data and wraps the model-visible value as data; the next high-sensitivity call is re-approved regardless of a remember or trusted-automation preset
items.android: carry the taint bit in the turn/task record and force approval at the shared ToolDispatcher gate; expiry, cancel and restart must not silently clear it before the turn ends

items.behavior: proposal/create/validate/install/revoke/restore/export/discard/redo/reduce/fault recovery retain per-version installation state and full-trust workshop consent
items.android: expose the same user-confirmed lifecycle through Compose; desktop full trust is evidence of upstream behavior only and grants no Android APP/LINUX/SHIZUKU/ROOT capability

items.behavior: consent cards describe detected studyData reads/writes, study events, pluginSchedule times, pluginSecrets use, network hosts and node modules; card settings keep secret values out of workshop.json
items.android: derive the same capability disclosure from the installed package and bind it to content digest approval; never persist a secret on the proposal card or export

items.behavior: plugin detail exposes ordinary config, secret config, owner data and install/trust as separate surfaces without copying installation state into portable records
items.android: keep data inspection/clearing separate from installation and trust; clearing creates replayable tombstones while secrets remain owner-scoped device records

items.behavior: ReviewPlan carries optional FSRS four-rating interval previews computed by the same scheduler as flashcards; SM-2 rows are converted lazily on preview/rating
items.android: parse and preserve rating_previews on ReviewPlan; four rating previews and question-bank plan scheduling use the S4.29 scheduler and match the desktop minutes/date values

items.behavior: media companion asks against a resource and streams ordered deltas; cancel is request-scoped; study cards are paged by limit/offset and preserve the source timestamp
items.android: keep requestId/resourceId ownership through cancel/restart, order deltas by seq, and persist card seconds without inventing a generated timestamp
